how_to_read: regret_min: minutes lost against the fastest choice under the weather that really happened. aircraft_sent_for_nothing: an aircraft was sent and the weather then closed. always_both loses no minutes by construction but sends an aircraft every time. weather_chance_check: the chance shown on screen against how often the weather held.

metrics.name: Aircraft sent for nothing in active weather (share of cases)
metrics.note: 200 cases with a storm or unflyable hour within 3 hours at the pick-up airport. Lower is better. Synthetic cases replayed on real 2024 weather; aircraft simulated, road times modeled. Compared with the old rule that looks only at the weather right now. Forecaster: lightgbm-v1.

metrics.name: Minutes lost in active weather against the best choice in hindsight
metrics.note: Lower is better. Sending both vehicles every time loses 0 minutes but launches an aircraft in every case.
